simple.meaning: חַגִּי (Chaggîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “Chaggi , an Israelite; also (patronymically) a Chaggite , or descendant of the same.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: חַגִּי (H2291) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 46:16, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חַגִּי (H2291) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in חַגִּי (H2291) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: חַגִּי (Chaggîy) / H2291 is traced through Genesis 46:16, Numbers 26:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
